mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates monetary easing that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces risk appetite, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market strength that precedes corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS up and UNRATE down) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 40% of instances or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (indicated by CPIAUCSL > 200), rising inflation pressures trigger preemptive monetary tightening expectations that depress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day SPX return when CPIAUCSL > 200 is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0%).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strengthening consumer demand that accelerates economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST up and RSAFS up) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 40% of instances or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that signals economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 110.0).
